title: Proximal Targets: Training Looped Refiners on Problems with Many Correct Answers
abstract: arXiv:2611.22737v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped refiners such as HRM and TRM apply one small network repeatedly to a draft answer, and deep supervision trains every pass toward one stored answer per puzzle. We prove that when a puzzle has many correct answers this target sets a loss floor that no model capacity removes, and that the loss-minimising pass blends the answers into an invalid grid. We propose the proximal target: train each pass toward the correct answer nearest to its own input, found by scanning a list of answers, by a search solver started at the draft, or within a band of quality set by a knob; correct answers become fixed points, and a pass only has to make fewer errors than its input has for the loop to converge, which its training loss bounds. translated_title: 近端目标：在存在多个正确答案的问题上训练循环精炼器
translated_abstract: 循环精炼器（如HRM和TRM）将一个小型网络反复应用于草稿答案，深度监督使每次迭代都朝向每个谜题存储的单一答案进行训练。我们证明，当谜题存在多个正确答案时，这种目标会设定一个任何模型容量都无法消除的损失下限，且损失最小化的迭代会将多个答案混合成无效的网格。我们提出近端目标：训练每次迭代朝向距离其自身输入最近的正确答案，该答案可通过扫描答案列表找到、通过从草稿出发的搜索求解器找到，或在由旋钮设定的质量带内找到；正确答案成为不动点，每次迭代只需比其输入犯更少的错误，循环即可收敛，且训练损失为这一收敛提供了界。使用相同的170万参数网络和5个随机种子，近端目标在具有2-64个答案的数独谜题上达到98.8%的解题率（标准目标仅为2.5%），在超过10,000个答案且无任何答案列表的稀疏谜题上达到93.8%的解题率。
tldr: 提出近端目标训练方法，让循环精炼网络的每次迭代朝向离其输入最近的正确答案收敛，在存在多个正确答案的问题上将解题准确率从2.5%大幅提升至98.8%。
en_tdlr: Proximal targets train looped refiners toward the correct answer nearest to each pass's input, converting correct answers into fixed points and boosting accuracy on multi-answer problems from 2.5% to 98.8%.
